firstPlayerRule: Choose the first expedition leader: use the player who most recently visited a rainforest, with Costa Rica taking precedence, or randomly select someone using the explorers in one group.
clarifications: Both the rainforest criterion and the explorer draw are official ways to select the opening leader.
internalEvidence: The publisher-hosted Mayfair English PDF was indexed in the web research source; the Setup text identifies the latest rainforest visitor (Costa Rica wins) or random selection using one explorer group. Direct retrieval was denied by the publisher CDN on 2026-09-23, so no rendered page or file hash was available. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the starter instruction, edition, and stated alternatives.
uncertainty: The rules do not prescribe a separate tie-break if several players visited the same rainforest at the same time; the official random method remains available.
